items.issue: The narration treats refusal to drink or play as evidence of disrespect and pressures participation through the idea of giving face.
items.disposition: Never convert this into advice to pressure alcohol, games or continued attendance; preserve each person's right to decline or leave.

items.issue: The closing labels and predictions demean women and assert reputational and age-related outcomes without evidence.
items.disposition: Mark do_not_generalize and exclude from first-person or action-advice use.

items.issue: The described person, gathering, reason for phone use and other participants' perspectives are not shown.
items.disposition: Record only the speaker's judgment; do not present the scenario or motive as verified fact.

items.issue: Formal sources already cover persistent phone use as a possible disengagement signal with stronger limits and a direct-question option.
